request.subject: UNIT:DINOSAUR:KNIGHT

layers.text: Remove the red cape, the red scarf and the red ankle bands, leaving bare hide. The hide becomes plain slate blue, colour #4f73a6, darker navy #26375c along the back and tail top; the belly, throat and lower jaw warm cream. Add a short crest of bright amber-orange #f08c1e spikes over the brow and down the neck. Nothing red is left. Keep the head, eyes, teeth, arms, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
